prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high for unsuccessful tests, but underestimated the gains of winning tests.
Specific layout redesigns (grid view companion, centered sign-in, two-column path choice, compact companion selection) were helpful, though other redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Adding new onboarding screens consistently failed, performing worse or showing no clear effect.
Reordering the onboarding flow performed worse or showed no clear effect.
Most copy changes showed no clear effect, except clear re-authentication sign-in copy which was helpful.
Adding wait info, hints, notifications, shortcut guides, or status banners showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -14.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +8.6% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +10.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +4.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -4.3% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +5.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -7.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.6% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +5.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 82.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 79.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Finish Welcome Redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a spotlight layout centered around activating the desktop pet. (why: Finish step has the lowest conversion in the funnel (64.8%) with high completion time (median 395s, mean 5815s).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Access Hint: Add a text hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign in with their previous account to automatically locate existing pets. (why: 8 support emails were reported about pets going missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Adoption Certificate View: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout to separate pet summary details from certificate input fields. (why: Adoption has high drop-off and long completion time (median 89s, mean 1017s).)
3: [home, redesign] Carousel Waiting Stage Redesign: Change the waiting screen layout to a carousel structure while pet assets load into memory. (why: The waiting stage takes median 201s and mean 2336s, and support reported users confused when pets fail to render.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Card Story Intro Redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen into a focused card layout highlighting key pet interaction capabilities. (why: Choose path step takes mean 514s; improving initial visual engagement sets clearer expectations early.)
5: [adoption, hint] Pet Photo Upload Help Hint: Provide a descriptive hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit, forward-facing photos. (why: 3 support tickets involved custom pet generation failing or producing distorted results.)
6: [finish, layout] Finish Step Mascot Preview Component: Add an animated mascot preview component to the home intro screen showing the pet active on desktop. (why: Users take 395s median at finish step and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to see or interact with the pet.)
7: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Sound Preview Screen: Insert a companion audio preview screen right after pet selection to test sound effects before finalizing adoption. (why: Provides immediate feedback during adoption to reduce confusion before generation.)
8: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Launch Button Copy: Update the home intro primary action button label to 'Launch Pet onto Desktop'. (why: Finish step drop-off is highest (64.8% conversion, mean 5815s), requiring explicit clarity on final launch.)
9: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Step Counter Display: Enable the step counter on the choose path screen so users know how many steps remain. (why: Overall onboarding conversion is 27.1%, so visual progress markers help maintain momentum from the start.)
